title: Synthetic example: resort with a family trip (ruled out)

reasons: No ring-like pattern among the highest-priority reviewers checked.

evidence.text: 8 reviewers share travel businesses within one region, and their histories look like ordinary travellers'. Consistent with a group trip; not counted.
8 of the latest 78 reviews arrived within 3 days (normally about 4 a week); 8 of them are 5★. Consistent with an in-store review drive or a campaign.

caveats: This is a pattern, not proof.
Only the newest 88 reviews and the 25 highest-priority reviewers were examined.
Dates in reviewer histories are approximate.
Rings within a single city aren't detected.
Google may already have removed some reviews.
